body: Never forget when Snoop Dogg sat in his car listening to the Frozen soundtrack and posted it on Instagram back in 2020 Snoop was enjoying his own little Disney moment and decided the whole timeline needed to see it. No explanation needed, just him in the car letting the soundtrack play There’s something about seeing Snoop listening to Frozen that makes the clip even better.

source_caption_text:
Never forget when Snoop Dogg sat in his car listening to the Frozen soundtrack and posted it on Instagram back in 2020 😭😂❄️

Snoop was enjoying his own little Disney moment and decided the whole timeline needed to see it. No explanation needed, just him in the car letting the soundtrack play 😂

There’s something about seeing Snoop listening to Frozen that makes the clip even better. Sometimes you need a break from your usual playlist, and apparently Disney was the choice that day 💀

Six years later, this is still worth bringing back 😭

What’s a song people would never expect to find on your playlist? 👀
